description: V3 ACTIVITY CONTESTS (city events the Games Master can draw): Courier Rush (3h, courier deliveries), Night Run Special (6h, Night Run points), Atrium Looting (3h, $ZENI looted from apartment raids), Bounty Season (12h, wanted agents caught), Police Crackdown (6h, crimes pulled off) and Companion Mixer (6h, jobs paid to your companion's agent). Shows which are on now with the live top 10 (citizens and guests are labelled and cannot win), time left, how scoring works, and the next one if known. Top declared player wins a crate; an owner raffle prize may be added. Read only, no token, no wallets shown.
